currentParagraphText: “I do hope this can stay between you and me, as very few people know this,” the Sword Saint began. “During a system event, the Chosen of the Malefic Viper, myself, and many other elites of Earth entered something known as the Treasure Hunt, which happened to take place in the ancient world of Yalsten...”

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “I do hope this can stay between you and me, as very few people know this,” the Sword Saint began. “During a system event, the Chosen of the Malefic Viper, myself, and many other elites of Earth entered something known as the Treasure Hunt, which happened to take place in the ancient world of Yalsten...”
finalResult.nextParagraphText: Miyamoto proceeded to explain what had happened, naturally leaving out quite a few details here and there but still touching on the essential parts. Fairleigh had clearly known a lot of what the Sword Saint said, but he still listened with great interest as the tale was soon over.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: The Sword Saint had considered for a long time if he would risk exposing the item he’d gained during the Treasure Hunt and had decided that the benefits now outweighed the risk.
